The House Committee on Regulated Industries offers Bill 187 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Washburn of the following substitute to HB 187: 144th, Powell of the 33rd, McDonald III of the 26th, Carpenter of the 4th, McCollum of the 30th, and others
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Titles 8, 10, 36, 43, and 46 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to buildings and housing, commerce and trade, local government, professions and businesses, and public … 1155 This Act shall become effective upon its approval by the Governor or upon its becoming law 1156 without such approval.
1157 SECTION 3-2. 1158 All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
